```{python}
import geopandas as gpd
import folium
import leafmap.foliumap as leafmap
from folium.plugins import Search

geojson_file = "data/cny_churches_2026.geojson"

gdf = gpd.read_file(geojson_file)

m = leafmap.Map(
    center=[42.45, -76.5],
    zoom=9,
    basemap="OpenStreetMap",
    width="70%",
    height="700px",
)

# Add churches as actual map markers
churches = folium.GeoJson(
    gdf.to_json(),
    name="Diocese of Central NY Churches",
    popup=folium.GeoJsonPopup(
        fields=[
            "Name",
            "Address",
            "County",
            "Website",
        ],
        aliases=[
            "Church:",
            "Address:",
            "County:",
            "Website:",
        ],
        localize=True,
        labels=True,
    ),
    tooltip=folium.GeoJsonTooltip(
        fields=["Name"],
        aliases=["Church:"],
    ),
    marker=folium.Marker(
        icon=folium.Icon(
           icon="map-marker",
           prefix="fa",
           color="blue",
           )
    )
)
churches.add_to(m)

# Search the same layer
Search(
    layer=churches,
    search_label="Address_Search",
    geom_type="Point",
    placeholder="Search addresses...",
    collapsed=False,
    position="topleft",
    search_zoom=15,
).add_to(m)

m.add_geojson(
    "data/cny_diocese_counties.geojson",
    layer_name="Diocese of Central NY Counties",
    style={
        "color": "#186420",
        "weight": 2,
        "fillColor": "#186420",
        "fillOpacity": 0.10,
    },
    interactive=False
)

m
```
